rv.q: This odd little show has charm aplenty, though for some it may also prove something of a well-intentioned dog's dinner.
A quirky and deliberately messy production.
The strong performances do rescue the play, but unlike Sarita's loving acceptance of her adopted dog, we never fully embrace it.

cn.t: Critics find this quirky pet-centered play more peculiar than successful, with its concept of actors playing talking dogs yielding mixed results and limited comedic payoff.
